name: futbolclub
description: Aplicación web para crear alineaciones, gestionar planteles y organizar fútbol amateur.

scripts.test:backups: npm run build:client && playwright test tests/backup-recovery.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.test:functional: playwright test tests/smoke.spec.js tests/guest-free-mode.spec.js tests/mobile-ux.spec.js tests/schema-security.spec.js tests/static-quality.spec.js tests/backup-recovery.spec.js tests/web-vitals.spec.js tests/runtime-architecture.spec.js --project=chromium
scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts service-worker.js playwright.config.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts service-worker.js playwright.config.js eslint.config.js package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts service-worker.js playwright.config.js eslint.config.js package.json
scripts.quality:core: npm run test:architecture && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:mutation && npm run test:source-budgets
scripts.quality: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run quality:core && npm run test:functional
